title: The Mall Beneath the Mall
hook: Security cameras in a dying mall show a lower food court that was never built, full of shoppers from stores that closed years ago.
truth: The mall's buried service level has become a hunger-place where abandoned brands, bad promises, and missing shoppers are traded as offerings.

monster.name: The Lower Mall
monster.instinct: To keep people browsing until they forget what they came for and who is waiting outside.

countdown.label: First Sign
countdown.text: A camera shows an escalator going down where the floor plan shows storage.

countdown.label: First Loss
countdown.text: A teenager vanishes after following a pop-up sale notification.

countdown.label: Temptation
countdown.text: Closed stores reopen below with perfect versions of things people regret losing.

countdown.label: Feed
countdown.text: The lower food court fills with shoppers who never blink and never leave.

countdown.label: Crisis
countdown.text: The real mall begins losing exits, one gate at a time.

countdown.label: Finale
countdown.text: The Lower Mall announces a grand reopening and invites the whole city inside.

clues.text: A receipt is dated next week and lists a store demolished in 2003.
Receipts point the way out only when followed from newest purchase to oldest.
Every security gate must close together or the lower level opens another entrance.
Each victim was offered exactly what they wanted to undo.
A store jingle contains the names of missing shoppers in the backing vocals.
A maintenance map shows a buried service corridor labelled only as Returns.

keeperHints: Make the mall mundane first: bad tile, closed kiosks, stale cinnamon, locked gates.
Temptation should be personal but never require inventing private backstory without permission.
Use retail language as ritual language.
revealPolicy: Show the place feeding on regret before naming it as a predator.
automationSafety: Do not decide what a player character most wants; ask or offer broad sensory temptation.
Always leave one practical exit visible until the finale countdown stage.
